summary: Iteration 89 — Backend + web + mobile e2e verification of the 3 new Phase F+ merchant features (Promo Analytics, Auto-Renew, Category Spotlight auction). BACKEND: 14/14 pytest passed. (1) Promo Analytics: /api/merchant/marketplace/promotion/analytics returns has_data=true + tier + views + impressions + orders + revenue_cents + extra_views/impressions/orders/revenue_cents + prior{}; anon 401. POST /api/shop/track {business_id,kind:'impression'|'view'} (no auth) increments promotion_daily and analytics counters grew from imp0 → imp0+3 and views0 → views0+2 after firing 3 impressions + 2 view beacons. (2) Auto-Renew: GET /promotion returns business_id + active{} + auto_renew + saved_cards[] + default_pm. POST /promotion/{id}/auto-renew toggles the flag; True → False → True re-verified via re-GET. wrong promotion_id → 404. (3) Category auction: /category-bid/categories returns list including 'restaurant'. GET /category-bid returns bid + standing{competitors,top_bid_cents,rank,outbid,my_bid_cents,suggested_bid_cents}. POST /set validates bid_cents 1..1000 (0 → 422, 1_000_000 → 422); mutating bid_cents persists via re-GET. POST /pause → status=paused; POST /resume → active|pending_budget. POST /topup/checkout returns real Stripe checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com/ + session_id starting with cs_. (4) Ranking + billing: GET /shop/businesses?category=restaurant places biz_dc324d800f66 FIRST with promoted=true + spotlight=true, and budget_cents drops by bid_cents (5c) per served response. GET /shop/home has 'Promoted near you' section with items including the merchant biz or biz_sample_ambreens. WEB: /shop/merchant/promote (merchant test@bigfm.dubai) rendered all 11 testIDs (rl-merchant-promote-page, promote-active, promote-analytics, promote-autorenew-toggle, promote-category-spotlight, promote-bid-category, promote-bid-cents, promote-bid-save, promote-bid-standing, promote-topup-amount, promote-topup-btn). Analytics card showed live counters (3 Views / 4 Impressions / 0 Orders / $0.00 Revenue) — proving beacons flowed end-to-end. Standing card showed 'You're #1 of 1 in restaurant · top bid 5¢ · your bid 5¢ · budget $999.95 left'. Auto-renew toggle round-tripped True → False → True in-UI. Bid save worked. Top-up button opened Stripe hosted checkout in a new tab ('Category Spotlight budget — TEST_iter57_pickup · US$10.00') — verified up to the checkout page as required. MOBILE (Expo web preview @ 390x844, demo-login-btn): /merchant/promote renders promote-root + all 3 tier cards + Category Spotlight block (promote-category-spotlight + promote-bid-cat-* chips + promote-bid-cents + promote-bid-save). No react-native red screen. promote-analytics / promote-autorenew-toggle / promote-active / promote-topup-* are conditionally rendered (analytics needs has_data; active/auto-renew need an active promotion; topup input needs an existing bid) — demo user has no active promotion and no saved bid yet, so these correctly hide. Shop tab renders 9 orange 'Promoted' badges parity, confirming the promoted rail + spotlight bidders surface identically to web.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/shop.py:28-38 — POST /api/shop/track is unauthenticated and accepts any business_id + kind without validation. An attacker can inflate a competitor's 'impressions' counter, artificially depleting their prepaid Category Spotlight budget (bill_impressions decrements budget_cents per served impression via the read path, not per beacon, so beacons don't drain budgets — but they DO fake extra_views/impressions in analytics, misleading merchants about promo ROI). Consider rate-limiting per-IP + ignoring beacons for business_ids not currently shown to that session, or signing beacons with a short-lived nonce.

backend/routes/shop.py:126-142 — /shop/businesses bills bid_impressions for the entire want-slice regardless of whether the requester is a real user. Any anonymous client can burn a competitor's budget by hammering GET /shop/businesses?category=restaurant. Consider rate limiting and requiring current_user_optional to be non-null for billing, or a per-session cap.

backend/services/category_bids.py:37-46 — bill_impressions uses two conflicting operators for budget_cents in the same update ($inc.budget_cents: -bid AND checks new_budget from Python-side subtraction). Not a functional bug, but reads then writes budget without a Mongo find_one_and_update; two concurrent shop-list calls can double-bill or miss the 'depleted' transition. Consider aggregating with $inc and moving depletion into a filter/$expr guard.

backend/routes/marketplace_category_bids.py:143-163 — GET /topup/{session_id}/status has no ownership check; any authenticated user can poll another merchant's session_id and (if paid) fire the credit path via retrieve. Add owner_user_id verification against the topup row.

backend/routes/marketplace_promotions.py:326-375 — sweep_renewals is called from /promotion GET + /shop/home GET with 45s throttle, but the throttle is per-process (module-level dict). Multi-worker uvicorn will bypass it. Consider a Mongo advisory lock or moving to a real scheduled task.
